description: High contention behavior, queueing, and backpressure interaction at 256 concurrent connections. Loopback will likely saturate the target; results are exploratory until perf-box-amd64 run.
loopback_caveat: 256 connections on loopback will likely saturate the target. Results are NOT equivalent to network-path benchmarks and NOT comparable to concurrent-32 results without explicit caveat. transport_mode must match the protocol-specific fixed contract in all result artifacts (loopback-h1 for H1, loopback-h2c for H2).

concurrency.note: Fixed at 256 connections. High-contention scenario. Do not compare directly to concurrent-32 results.

h3.reason: H3/QUIC requires dedicated QUIC toolchain not confirmed in runtime/drivers.

claim_scope_note: Must NOT be compared to concurrent-32 results without explicit concurrency-axis caveat. Promote to comparison_eligible only after repeated runs on perf-box-amd64.
